description: Show a shot in Dinoctor's editor so the person sees what you're working on. Name it with shot_id, or scene and shot indexes. Changes only what's on screen, not the project. Edit tools use the shot on screen when no shot is given, so this also sets their default. Returns { showing }. To get a picture of the shot, use look_at_shot.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: go_to
